placement.deliberate_difference: Crimson Cabaret revision restores the selected seated figure, text panels and flags. Ground porch projects 3.2 construction units beyond the enclosed facade and 1.6 beyond the upper gallery; awning covers the projecting porch. Overall X/Z envelope retained at 0.824038 x 0.850095 by fitting the complete structure; enclosed body is shallower to reserve porch space. Height about 1.27 rather than the legacy 2.060096. No extra scene lights.
